data.title: 椎名真由理 · 猫耳女仆的午后特调
data.description: 在人声喧闹的MayQueen咖啡厅里，真由理端着盛有蛋包饭的餐盘快步走来。她微微倾身，用番茄酱画好笑脸后双手合十在胸前，眼睛弯成月牙。
data.location: bustling retro Akihabara maid cafe with checkered floors and warm booths
data.action: leaning over wooden table holding decorated omelet rice plate, hands clasped happily over apron, beaming with cheerful sparkling eyes
data.lighting: warm cozy indoor chandelier lighting casting soft golden highlights on brown uniform
data.mood: bubbly retro sweetness, energetic maid service, pure heart-melting charm
data.promptProse: Leaning forward in her brown maid dress at a cafe table, Mayuri presents an omelet plate with joyful eyes and hands clasped together in delight.
data.animaCaption: Mayuri Shiina serving decorated food in her Victorian maid uniform with radiant joy.
